verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show payouts to a linked bank account, with payouts and expected deposit dates trackable in the Dashboard. Financial report runs for balance, payouts and activity produce downloadable CSVs, and the MCP tooling exposes balance transactions. However, no evidence shows a payout-level report that itemizes fees, refunds and chargebacks against each bank deposit. Refunds and disputes are documented only as separate operational features, not as reconciliation line items. missing for 10: explicit payout-to-deposit reconciliation report documentation, itemized fee/refund/chargeback breakdown per settlement, independent or hands-on corroboration of reconciliation workflows
